name: gitlab-pane-tooling
description: Dev-time tooling only: the checks, generators and screenshots of the gitlab-pane mod. The mod itself has no npm packages and ships none (release/files leaves this file out).

scripts.check: npm run check:fast && npm run scan
scripts.check:fast: npm run files && npm run knip && npm run lint && npm run types && npm run schema -- types --check && npm run release-tree -- check && npm run docs -- check && npm run validate
scripts.lint: node tools/engine_types.ts && eslint --max-warnings 0 hooks tests tools
scripts.types: node tools/engine_types.ts && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tools/store-probe/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript-7/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.validate: claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict tools/store-probe
scripts.test: vitest run && claude plugin test . && node tools/pane_screens.ts scenes

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: npm run check:fast && npm run scan -- --staged
